cues.en: CGA was the first graphics card made for the IBM PC. It came out in 1981 and was produced in various forms to approximately 1987. Now, EGA graphics came out about three years later and then BGA a few years after that. Also, there was the PCjr. 101000 graphics that competed with all of these in the market. So, what happened to all of those graphics options?
cues.zh: CGA 是为 IBM PC 打造的第一款显卡。它于 1981 年推出，以各种形式生产到大约 1987 年。后来，EGA 显卡在大约三年后问世，再过几年又推出了 BGA。此外，市场上还有 PCjr. 101000 显示技术与之竞争。那么，这些显示规格后来都怎么样了呢？

cues.en: Well, BGA eventually morphed into SPGA and continues in one form or another into the present day. The others continued to be supported by software for several more years after they were discontinued. In fact, during this period of time it was not uncommon for a new game to support all four standards. I should mention that EGA was backwards compatible with CGA, and BGA was backwards compatible with EGA, and thus by default CGA as well.
cues.zh: 嗯，BGA 最终演变成了 SPGA，并以某种形式一直延续至今。其他几种在停产后，软件依然对它们支持了好几年。事实上，在那段时期，一款新游戏同时支持这四种标准是很常见的。这里要提一下，EGA 向下兼容 CGA，而 BGA 向下兼容 EGA，因此默认也兼容 CGA。

cues.en: The Tandy graphics was only backwards compatible with CGA. Due to this backwards compatibility, one of the things I always did with MS-DOS games was to try playing the game in all of the graphics modes to see how it looked and how the experience changed. You can see how this game looks in VGA mode, as compared to CGA mode. CGA looks, well, terrible.
cues.zh: Tandy 图形则仅向下兼容 CGA。正是因为这种向下兼容性，我玩 MS-DOS 游戏时总喜欢在所有显示模式下都试玩一下，看看画面如何，体验有什么不同。你可以看看这款游戏在 VGA 模式下和 CGA 模式下的对比。CGA 的画面嘛，可以说是惨不忍睹。

cues.en: Before you dismiss CGA as being all that bad, let me walk you through some of the technical details of it and then I have a few surprises for you. A true CGA card supports two different types of monitor, RGBI and composite. Composite you probably already know about. It's that little round RCA jack that's been in use for decades and most modern televisions still have at least one of these jacks on them.
cues.zh: 在你把 CGA 贬得一无是处之前，先让我带你了解一下它的一些技术细节，之后我还会给你看几个惊喜。一块真正的 CGA 卡支持两种不同类型的显示器：RGBI 和复合显示器。复合接口你大概已经知道了，就是那个用了几十年的圆形 RCA 插孔，大多数现代电视机上至少都还有一个这种接口。

cues.en: The RGBI standard, on the other hand, has been obsolete since the 1980s. It used a 9-pin D-sub connector. Let me show you what the pins on this thing did. Pins 3, 4, and 5 were for your red, green, and blue signals. So these were digital signals that were either on or off, and there was no in-between shades. So, by using them in different combinations, you could create these 8 colors. Pin 6 was called intensity.
cues.zh: 而 RGBI 标准早在 20 世纪 80 年代就被淘汰了。它采用的是 9 针 D-sub 接口。我来带大家看看上面的引脚都是做什么用的。第 3、4、5 针分别传输红、绿、蓝信号。这些是数字信号，只有开和关两种状态，没有中间过渡色。因此，通过它们的不同组合，你可以组合出这 8 种颜色。第 6 针被称为高亮（Intensity）。

cues.en: This signal basically added one additional level of brightness to the colors, giving you 8 more possible colors. So there's the whole 16 color palette of CGA graphics. As you can see, the limitation of 16 colors comes directly from the monitor itself. But, CGA has many more limitations beyond this. It only has 16 kilobytes of video RAM. So, compromises had to be made. So there were several modes of operation. The first was an 80x25 text mode, of which all 16 colors were available at the same time.
cues.zh: 这个信号基本上就是给颜色多加了一级亮度，从而又多出了 8 种可选颜色。这就是 CGA 图形的全部 16 色调色板。正如你所见，16 色的限制直接来自于显示器本身。但 CGA 的限制远不止于此。它只有 16 KB 的显存，所以必须做出妥协。因此它提供了几种工作模式，首先是 80x25 文本模式，这种模式下可以同时显示全部 16 种颜色。

cues.en: Even some games like this one run in text mode and can take full advantage of the 16 colors. The most commonly used graphics mode was the 320x200 mode with 4 colors. The trouble is, the particular 4 colors available were horrible shades of black, cyan, magenta, and white. When playing a CGA game, this is the most common mode and you can see it looks pretty ugly.
cues.zh: 甚至有些游戏（比如这款）就是在文本模式下运行的，能够充分利用这 16 种颜色。最常用的图形模式是 4 色的 320x200 模式。问题在于，它能用的这 4 种颜色搭配非常糟糕：黑、青、品红和白。在玩 CGA 游戏时，这是最常见的模式，你可以看到画面确实挺难看的。

cues.en: But wait, there were 3 other official palettes that a game could choose from. Let's see if the next one is any better. Not really. It's basically a darker version of the first palette. What about the next? Yeah, not a great combination there either. Yuck! And then you get one more which is a darker version of the last one. Some games, like Total Eclipse, would actually switch palettes on you when going from room to room in order to mix things up a bit and add a little variety. So, there was a high resolution video mode available with double the pixels.
cues.zh: 等等，游戏还可以选择另外 3 套官方调色板。看看下一套会不会好点。并没有。它基本就是第一套调色板的更暗版本。那下一套呢？嗯，那组配色也不行。呕！然后还有一套，是上一套的更暗版本。有些游戏，比如 Total Eclipse，会在你从一个房间走到另一个房间时切换调色板，增加一点变化和多样性。所以，当时有一个高分辨率视频模式，像素数是两倍。

cues.en: But, because there was no additional video RAM to handle it, the color had to be sacrificed. And you're now limited to just two colors. A few games, like SimCity, actually did exploit this mode since they figured extra detail was more important than the colors. There was also an undocumented 160 by 100 mode, which is really chunky, but at least it was able to produce all 16 colors at the same time.
cues.zh: 但因为没额外显存支持，只能牺牲颜色。于是只剩两种颜色。少数游戏比如 SimCity 确实用了这种模式，因为它们认为细节比颜色更重要。还有一个未公开的 160x100 模式，画质很糙，但至少能同时显示全部 16 色。

cues.en: This is actually a modified version of text mode. And very few games actually take advantage of this, but Paku Paku is an example of one that does. It's a nifty clone of Pac-Man and it's very playable. OK, so CGA probably doesn't look like it's very good for playing video games. But if you're thinking that, it's probably because you've only ever seen it connected to an RGB-I monitor. Remember how I said that EGA and VGA were backwards compatible with CGA? Well, that isn't entirely true.
cues.zh: 这其实是文本模式的修改版。很少有游戏真正利用它，但 Paku Paku 是一个例子。它是 Pac-Man 的精巧克隆，而且很好玩。好，CGA 看起来似乎不太适合玩游戏。但如果你这么想，可能只是因为你只见过它接 RGB-I 显示器。还记得我说 EGA 和 VGA 向下兼容 CGA 吗？其实并不完全对。

cues.en: They're only backwards compatible with the RGBi mode of CGA. Now, take a look at this laptop from 1994. Now, this laptop has VGA graphics and it is backwards compatible with CGA. I'm going to show you Maniac Mansion. It's a really interesting case to use because it's one of the few games that can switch graphics modes on the fly. If you press shift C, it will switch to CGA mode. Or shift E to go back to EGA.
cues.zh: 它们只向下兼容 CGA 的 RGBi 模式。看看这台 1994 年的笔记本。这台笔记本有 VGA 图形，并且向下兼容 CGA。我给你们展示 Maniac Mansion。它是个很有意思的例子，因为它是少数能即时切换图形模式的游戏。按 Shift+C 会切到 CGA 模式。或者按 Shift+E 回到 EGA。

cues.en: Now, CGA looks pretty terrible, doesn't it? I mean, yeah, who would want to play this? Now, let me show you a different kind of laptop and prepare to be blown away. This old Tandy 1400 LT laptop was generously donated from Jad Garcia. Thanks Jad. This is one of the first true DOS compatible laptops. And while this was produced in 1987, it's functionally equivalent to an IBM Turbo XT from several years earlier. Early laptops were always a good bit behind on technology.
cues.zh: CGA 看起来挺糟糕，对吧？我是说，是啊，谁想玩这个？现在让我展示另一种笔记本，准备好大开眼界。这台旧的 Tandy 1400 LT 笔记本由 Jad Garcia 慷慨捐赠。谢谢 Jad。这是最早真正兼容 DOS 的笔记本之一。它生产于 1987 年，功能上却相当于几年前的 IBM Turbo XT。早期笔记本在技术上总是落后不少。

cues.en: It has no hard drive, just dual 720K floppies. And while it has the Tandy logo on the front, it does not have the famous Tandy 1000 graphics and sound. Instead, it just has plain old CGA graphics and PC speaker sound. Even though it uses CGA, the built-in LCD screen is monochrome and about the worst thing ever for playing games. But, the one thing it does have is an RGBi,
cues.zh: 它没有硬盘，只有两个 720K 软驱。虽然正面有 Tandy 标志，却没有著名的 Tandy 1000 图形和声音。它只有普通的老式 CGA 图形和 PC 扬声器声音。虽然用 CGA，内置 LCD 屏是单色的，用来玩游戏大概是最糟的。但它有一个 RGBi，

cues.en: and a composite output, like a true CGA card would have on a desktop computer. So, most laptops from this time period do not have the composite video port, so this is quite an unusual laptop. So, let me hook this laptop into a television and see how things look. Remember when we looked at Maniac Mansion earlier? Let's look at it now. Wow, what happened to those ugly four color palettes? Well, technically speaking, composite mode still only has four colors.
cues.zh: 以及复合视频输出，就像台式机上的真正 CGA 卡那样。当时大多数笔记本没有复合视频端口，所以这台相当少见。让我把这台笔记本接到电视上看看效果。还记得之前看的 Maniac Mansion 吗？现在再看看。哇，那些难看的四色调色板怎么了？严格来说，复合视频模式仍然只有四种颜色。

cues.en: However, by placing pixels in certain patterns on the screen, other colors will emerge due to NTSC artifacting. This is basically the same technique used by the Apple II only on steroids. So you start off with your four ugly primary colors, but if you mix black and cyan you get blue. If you mix black and magenta you get dark blue and so on. So these four primary colors are used to create 16. But you can change the primary palette to one of the other ones and you get a whole different set of colors.
cues.zh: 不过，通过在屏幕上以特定图案排列像素，由于 NTSC 伪影，会出现其他颜色。这基本上和 Apple II 用的是同一种技术，只是效果更猛。你一开始只有四种难看的基色，但如果你把黑色和青色混合，就会得到蓝色。把黑色和洋红混合，就会得到深蓝色，等等。所以这四种基色被用来生成 16 种颜色。但你可以把主调色板换成其他调色板之一，从而得到一整套完全不同的颜色。

cues.en: So you can have 16 colors on screen at once, out of a palette of about 64 colors to choose from. From this point on, I'm going to use this Commodore 1084 monitor. One of the great things about it is that it supports many different types of video, including RGBi and composite. So I can connect it to both outputs on this laptop at the same time and use this switch to change between them. This way we can compare how each game appears in RGBi or composite mode with the flick of a switch.
cues.zh: 所以你可以在屏幕上同时显示 16 种颜色，而可选调色板大约有 64 种颜色。从现在开始，我要用这台 Commodore 1084 显示器。它的一大优点是支持多种视频类型，包括 RGBi 和复合视频。所以我可以把它同时接到这台笔记本电脑的两个输出上，并用这个开关在两者之间切换。这样，我们只要拨一下开关，就能比较每个游戏在 RGBi 或复合视频模式下的样子。

cues.en: So, let's take a look at the game LHX Attack Chopper in composite video mode. I'm going to select the Osprey, that's my favorite one to fly. OK, so here's RGBi mode. And here's the same scene in composite. How about Maniac Mansion? Composite mode looks great and colorful. Although the CPU in this machine is kind of slow. Here's inside the house. Now, let's switch to RGB. Yuck! Let's switch back to composite.
cues.zh: 那么，来看看复合视频模式下的游戏 LHX Attack Chopper。我要选择 Osprey，这是我最喜欢飞的机型。好，这里是 RGBi 模式。这里是复合视频下的同一场景。Maniac Mansion 呢？复合视频模式看起来很棒，色彩丰富。虽然这台机器的 CPU 有点慢。这是房子内部。现在，切换到 RGB 看看。真难看！还是切回复合视频吧。

cues.en: Battle Chess is an interesting case. By default, it runs in RGBI mode on CGA and has that yucky four color look to it. And if you try to run it on a composite monitor, it looks kind of yucky there too. But, if you type in slash comp on the command line, it will start up the game in a special mode just for CGA composite monitors. And it looks fantastic by comparison. I would also like to point out that there was a demo made recently that used some software trickery to actually produce thousands of colors on CGA composite.
cues.zh: Battle Chess 是个有趣的例子。默认情况下，它在 CGA 上以 RGBI 模式运行，带有那种难看的四色外观。如果你试着在复合视频显示器上运行它，看起来也有点难看。但是，如果你在命令行输入 /comp，它就会以专门针对 CGA 复合视频显示器的特殊模式启动游戏。相比之下，看起来棒极了。我还想指出，最近有一个演示程序，用一些软件技巧在 CGA 复合视频上实际生成了数千种颜色。

cues.en: The demo is called 8088MPH and it has sort of a Back to the Future theme to it. It really shows what is possible with a CGA card in composite mode. So you might be asking yourself, since composite is so much better, why did it even have the RGBi mode to begin with? Well, RGBi mode shines when it comes to producing sharp, colorful, 80-colon text. So, take a look at this text on composite. And then on RGB.
cues.zh: 这个演示程序叫 8088MPH，它带有一点《回到未来》的主题。它真正展示了 CGA 卡在复合视频模式下能做到什么。所以你可能会问自己：既然复合视频好这么多，为什么它一开始还要有 RGBi 模式？嗯，RGBi 模式在生成清晰、彩色的 80 列文本时很出彩。那么，看看这段文本在复合视频下的效果。然后再看 RGB 下的效果。

cues.en: So, if you were a business and you needed to use spreadsheets or word processors back then, you would have been using text mode and that would have been more important than color graphics. So, by splitting the card like this, IBM was able to address both the business and the home market at the same time. So, here's where things get confusing. When you look at this time period, all of the CGA games designed back then were designed primarily to run on a composite monitor. But when you move to this time period,
cues.zh: 所以，如果你当时是一家企业，需要用电子表格或文字处理软件，你就会使用文本模式，而那比彩色图形更重要。所以，通过这样拆分显卡，IBM 能够同时面向商业和家庭市场。那么，接下来就是让人困惑的地方。看这个时期，当时设计的所有 CGA 游戏主要都是为在复合视频显示器上运行而设计的。但到了这个时期，

cues.en: Some CGA games were designed specifically to run on our GBI and don't look any better and often look even worse on composite. So, why is that? Well, I have one piece of speculation. Let's imagine for a moment that you're a developer
cues.zh: 有些 CGA 游戏是专门为 RGBI 设计的，在复合视频上看起来并没有更好，而且往往更糟。那么，为什么会这样？嗯，我有一个猜测。让我们先想象一下，你是一名开发者，

cues.en: and during this time period and you have a machine that uses VGA graphics. Now, you're going to be developing a game that its primary focus is going to be VGA. And CGA mode is going to be more or less an afterthought by this point in the industry. So, you don't even have a machine anymore that has a composite output on it. So, if you're coding the game, what mode of CGA are you going to prioritize? Well, the answer is you're going to code it for RGB mode. So,
cues.zh: 在这个时期，你有一台使用 VGA 图形的机器。现在，你要开发一款主要面向 VGA 的游戏。而到了这个行业阶段，CGA 模式或多或少只是个事后补充。所以你甚至已经没有一台带复合视频输出的机器了。那么，如果你在写这个游戏，你会优先考虑哪种 CGA 模式？答案就是，你会为 RGB 模式编写。所以，

cues.en: How does CGA graphics compare to its competitors? Well, during that time, all of its competitors used composite video as well. So, if you compare the composite video mode of CGA to, say, an Apple II or Commodore 64, I would say it's superior to both of them. And even if you compare it to, say, the Atari 800 series, it's
cues.zh: CGA 图形和它的竞争对手相比如何？嗯，在那个时期，它的所有竞争对手也都使用复合视频。所以，如果你把 CGA 的复合视频模式与，比如说 Apple II 或 Commodore 64 相比，我会说它比两者都更优秀。即使你把它与，比如说 Atari 800 系列相比，它也

cues.en: Still pretty close, but I'd still say CGA is probably superior. Yeah, so I think IBM CGA is probably the most underrated and misunderstood graphics card of all of IBM PC graphics history, perhaps right next to the Tandy 1000. In fact, I hope to do an episode on the Tandy 1000 graphics and sound at some point in the future. Anyway, I hope you enjoyed this and I'll see you next time.
cues.zh: 仍然相当接近，但我还是认为 CGA 可能更胜一筹。是的，所以我认为 IBM CGA 大概是 IBM PC 图形史上最被低估和误解的显卡，也许仅次于 Tandy 1000。事实上，我希望将来某个时候做一期关于 Tandy 1000 图形和声音的节目。总之，希望你喜欢这期内容，我们下次见。
